ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal track is on the left, point B is located near the left end of the horizontal track, and point O is on the right side of the horizontal track; from point O toward the upper right is a section of inclined track, and point A is on the inclined plane. The angle between the inclined plane and the horizontal dashed line is marked as θ; there is a dashed connecting line between points A and B, and the angle between this dashed line and the horizontal track is marked as α. Then reason: Let the length of the inclined segment AO be s, and the length of the horizontal segment OB be l. The vertical height of point A relative to point B is h=s sinθ; the horizontal distance from A to B is s cosθ+l. From the angle between AB and the horizontal in the figure being α, it can be obtained that tanα=h/(s cosθ+l). The small block is released from rest at A and finally stops at B, the initial and final kinetic energies are both 0, and there is no mechanical energy loss at the turn, so the decrease in gravitational potential energy is all used to overcome friction and do work. The friction force on the inclined plane is μmg cosθ, and the friction work is μmg cosθ·s; the friction work on the horizontal plane is μmg·l. Therefore mg h=μmg(s cosθ+l). Solving gives μ=h/(s cosθ+l). Combining the geometric relation h/(s cosθ+l)=tanα, the coefficient of kinetic friction is μ=tanα.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出轨道由右上方倾斜段 AO 和左侧水平段 OB 组成，A 在斜面上，B 在水平面上，AO 与水平夹角为 θ，虚线 AB 与水平方向夹角为 α。设斜面长度 AO=s，水平段 OB=l，则 A 相对 B 的竖直高度为 h=s sinθ，A 到 B 的水平距离为 s cosθ+l，所以由图中虚线几何关系有 tanα=h/(s cosθ+l)。再从题干读出物块从 A 静止释放，最终停在 B，斜面和水平面动摩擦因数相同且转折处无机械能损失。用能量守恒/功能关系：重力势能减少 mgh 全部克服摩擦做功；斜面摩擦功为 μmg cosθ·s，水平面摩擦功为 μmg·l。因此 mgh=μmg(s cosθ+l)，解得 μ=h/(s cosθ+l)=tanα。
